title: Laying Out Form
text: Select Form, choose Sphere, Inscribed Cube or Plane, then solid or hollow. Insert one block or item; ordinary items and complete multiblock machines appear as drops. Leave the slot empty to clear blocks at selected positions without consuming materials.

A plane may be parallel to YZ, XZ or XY. Spheres use the current radius; cubes fit completely inside that sphere. Hollow spheres have a single boundary, hollow cubes retain all six faces rather than a frame, and hollow planes have two-block-wide rings whose outer radius follows power.
Only selected shape positions are overwritten, including unbreakable blocks; hollow interiors remain untouched. Gravity, liquids and machines behave normally after placement.
